rows: How many leaves am I entitled to in a year?
Full-time employees get 12 Casual Leave, 12 Sick Leave and 18 Earned Leave per calendar year. Interns get 6 Casual and 6 Sick Leave.
Do unused leaves carry forward to next year?
Only Earned Leave carries forward, up to 15 days. Casual and Sick Leave lapse on 31 December.
Earned Leave accrues at 1.5 days per month of service, which is 18 days for a full year.
How do I apply for leave?
Open the HR portal, go to Leave, choose the leave type and dates and submit. Your reporting manager approves it and you get a notification.
Do weekends and public holidays count as leave days?
No. Only working days (Monday to Friday, excluding company holidays) are deducted. Maternity leave is counted in calendar days.
Do I need a medical certificate for sick leave?
Yes, if the sick leave is more than 2 consecutive days.
What happens if I take leave when I have no balance?
The days are treated as Loss of Pay. One day's gross salary (monthly gross divided by calendar days in the month) is deducted for each LOP day.
Can I cancel a leave that is already approved?
Yes. Cancel it in the portal before the start date. Your manager is notified and the days return to your balance.
What is the maternity leave policy?
Eligible women employees get 182 calendar days (26 weeks) of paid maternity leave.
Maternity, Paternity and Special Leave Policy
What is the paternity leave policy?
Fathers get 10 working days of paid paternity leave, to be taken within 6 months of the child's birth.
Maternity, Paternity and Special Leave Policy
How many days of marriage and bereavement leave do I get?
Marriage leave is 5 working days, once during employment. Bereavement leave is 3 working days for an immediate family member. Both are paid and do not reduce your regular leave balance.
Maternity, Paternity and Special Leave Policy
How many public holidays do we get?
The company declares 11 public holidays each year. The list is in the holiday calendar. Holidays that fall on a weekend are not compensated.
On the last working day of each month. The payslip is published in the HR portal on the same day.
What is the payroll cut-off date?
The 25th of every month. Attendance changes and reimbursements approved by the 25th are paid in that month's payroll; later ones go to the next month.
Where can I download my payslip?
In the HR portal under Payroll, then Payslips. For older payslips, raise a Payslip Copy request, which is issued within 1 working day.
Basic is 40% of CTC and HRA is 40% of Basic. Employer PF, gratuity and insurance are part of CTC and the balance is paid as Special Allowance. An intern's stipend is paid entirely as Basic.
How is Loss of Pay calculated?
Each LOP day deducts monthly gross divided by the number of calendar days in that month.
What is Professional Tax and how much is deducted?
Professional Tax is a state levy. Rs 200 per month is deducted when your monthly gross is Rs 15,000 or more.
How much PF is deducted from my salary?
12% of Basic on a wage ceiling of Rs 15,000, which is up to Rs 1,800 per month. The employer contributes an equal amount. Interns are not covered.
Which tax regime applies to me by default?
The New regime is the default. You can change your choice in the HR portal at the start of the financial year.
Form 16 for the previous financial year is issued by 15 June. You can also raise a Form 16 copy request.
By when should I submit investment proofs?
Investment proofs must be uploaded by 31 January. Declarations open in April.
When do salary increments take effect?
The appraisal cycle takes effect on 1 April. You are eligible if you joined on or before 30 September of the previous year.
How is the performance bonus calculated?
With at least one year of service and a rating of 3, 4 or 5, you get 0.5, 1.0 or 1.5 times your monthly Basic in the April payslip.
What does the group health insurance cover?
Employer-paid cover for you, your spouse and up to 2 children. Sum insured is Rs 5,00,000 for Fresher and Junior, Rs 7,50,000 for Mid and Rs 10,00,000 for Senior and Lead.
Can I add my parents to the health insurance?
Yes, through the optional Parental Top-up of Rs 3,00,000. You pay Rs 1,100 per month for one parent or Rs 2,100 for two, deducted from salary.
How do I add a spouse or a newborn to my cover?
Add them in the HR portal within 30 days of the marriage or birth.
When is the open enrollment window?
What life insurance cover do I have?
Employer-paid group term life of 3 times your annual CTC, capped at Rs 1 crore, plus personal accident cover of Rs 10,00,000.
Group Term Life and Personal Accident Policy
Do interns get insurance and PF benefits?
No. Interns are not covered under group health, life, accident, PF or gratuity.
Is there an annual health check-up?
Yes. Every full-time employee gets an annual health check-up worth up to Rs 3,000.
When am I eligible for gratuity?
After 5 years of continuous service. It accrues at 4.81% of Basic.
Yes. The Employee Assistance Programme offers free and confidential counselling sessions through an external provider.
What expenses can I claim and what are the limits?

Internet Rs 1,000 per month, Mobile Rs 500 per month, Wellness Rs 1,000 per month, Business travel Rs 30,000 per claim, Client entertainment Rs 5,000 per claim, Medical OPD Rs 15,000 per year, Learning Rs 30,000 per year, WFH equipment Rs 25,000 once in 3 years and Relocation Rs 50,000 once for eligible new joiners.
How long do I have to submit a claim?
Within 30 days of the expense. Travel and client entertainment must be submitted within 15 days, and medical, learning and relocation within 60 days.
Do I need to attach receipts?
Yes. Original invoices are mandatory. For travel and client entertainment, every item above Rs 250 needs a receipt.
When will my approved claim be paid?
Claims approved by the 25th are paid with that month's salary. Claims approved later are paid in the next month's payroll.
The usual reasons are a missing receipt, an amount above the limit, submission after the allowed window, a duplicate claim, or a non-reimbursable expense.
Hybrid and Remote employees can claim up to Rs 1,000 per month with the internet bill.
Can I claim for a home-office setup?
Yes. Hybrid and Remote employees can claim up to Rs 25,000 for home-office equipment once every 3 years.
Rs 30,000 per financial year for courses, certifications and books. Interns are not eligible.
How do I claim business travel?
Get your manager's approval before the trip and submit the claim with receipts within 15 days of returning. Economy flights and AC train travel are reimbursed at actuals up to Rs 30,000 per trip.
How do I request an employment verification letter?
In the HR portal, go to Documents, then Request a letter. It is issued as a signed PDF within 3 working days.
How long does a salary certificate take?
2 working days. It is issued only to confirmed employees.
When will I receive my experience and relieving letters?
After exit clearance. The experience letter takes 5 working days and the relieving letter 7 working days.
Can I get a copy of my appointment or increment letter?
Yes. Appointment letter copies take 1 working day and increment letter copies 2 working days.
It depends on your level: Intern 0 days, Fresher 30, Junior 30, Mid 60, Senior 60 and Lead 90 days.
How long is the probation period?
6 months for full-time employees. Interns have no probation.
How does the employee referral bonus work?
You earn Rs 10,000 to Rs 75,000 depending on the level of the person you refer, paid after they complete 90 days. Intern referrals do not earn a bonus.
What is the hybrid work policy?
Hybrid employees work from the office three days a week.
Who can see my personal data in the AI HR Helpdesk?
Only you. Managers see data of their direct reports where needed for approvals and HR administrators can see all data. Every personal-data answer is logged.
Employee Data Privacy and Helpdesk Access Policy
How do I raise a grievance or a POSH complaint?
Raise it through the HR helpdesk or contact the Internal Committee directly. Complaints are handled confidentially.
Code of Conduct and POSH Policy
